expected: After a mute is saved while a failing local run of that trigger is in flight, the failure the cancelled run reports afterwards is dropped and no local_action_failed issue exists.
actual: The stale FAILURE outcome delivered after the save re-created local_action_failed (data kind=switch, state_value=on) although the saved ON record has no local actions (AssertionError 'a stale failure of a run in flight must not re-open the issue').
semanticAssessment: Valid semantic RED. The target node was collected and executed (1 test, 0 errors, 0 skipped). Its premises held before the planned assertion: the in-flight run called test.flaky once, the saved ON record has no actions, and the held outcome list holds exactly one FAILURE from the cancelled run. The planned assertion then failed because the issue exists after the stale FAILURE was handed to async_report_local_outcome. That is the WR-06 defect itself (the guard only drops a failure whose record is gone), not a setup, import, collection or fixture failure.
